name: XT60PW-M
title: XT60PW-M: right-angle through-hole male XT60 power connector, two contacts, 35 A, 80 V DC
summary: A two-contact male (plug) power connector of the XT60 family that lies on its side on a circuit board, so its mate plugs in parallel to the board. The two copper-alloy, gold-plated contacts sit 7.20 mm apart and solder into holes in the board; a tab on each side of the yellow PA housing goes into a slot. It is rated 35 A at a temperature rise of 85 K or less and 80 V DC, with contact resistance of 1.2 mΩ or less, for 100 mating cycles, from -20 to 120 °C.
key_figures: 2, on a 7.20±0.05 mm pitch, through-hole solder

notes: Fields of the part number: XT is the series, 60 the product specification, PW the insulator specification, M the gender (male, plug), 30 the solder tail specification, G gold-plated contacts, Y a yellow housing.

pins.name: contact
pins.function: First power contact; its solder tail goes into a ø2.90 mm hole and stands 3.00 mm out from the housing.

pins.name: contact
pins.function: Second power contact, 7.20 mm from the first; same tail and hole.

pins.name: tab
pins.function: Two tabs, one each side of the housing, 13.50 mm apart; each goes into a 1.90 × 0.80 mm slot and stands 3.50 mm out from the housing.

rows: G = Gold Plated, N = Nickel Plated

operation.text: Choose a connector and cable rated for the circuit's current and voltage. Connect and disconnect with no load. Hold the housing, not the cables, while mating or separating, since pulling the cables can deform the connector and lead to poor contact. Align the two halves first and never force them together. The connector is a precision part: protect it from damage, bending and loss, and never take it apart.

Store sealed, dry and out of sunlight, clear of damp, corrosive gases and other harmful substances, at -20 to 25 °C and no more than 80 % humidity, for at most one year; keep from strong vibration and chemicals. Road, sea, air and rail transport all suit it, with protection from impact, violent vibration, rain, snow and sun.
